Source: 106 \mathbf hits in 5-paper corpus (vector notation).
Construct: \mathbf has no unicode-bold for arbitrary chars → preserve as TeX
within a math span that needs it. The simple span $x_i$ unicode-renders
to x<sub>i</sub> (consistent with rich-table-paper convention).
Bug-finder: catches the same lossy-collapse pattern as \mathbb (ARX-330).
If \mathbf{x} → bare x, that's a real bug.
